name: Boca Juniors 2000-01 (Carlos Bianchi)

Style named by sources: 4-3-1-2 with Riquelme as enganche, tactically flexible and adapting systems to players (not a fixed philosophy). Evidence is dense for the 2000 Libertadores final and the 2000 Intercontinental vs Real Madrid; the 2001 Libertadores run and the Bayern final are thin or absent. Tier A sources absent; mostly retrospectives (2016-2025) quoting 2000 events. Period start 2000-02 is month-level only (first match day not found).
openQuestions: Exact date of the first 2000 Libertadores match (Blooming away) not found on a page; period start is month-level only. Gap-pass searches were blocked by the session search budget.
